executive_summary: Original-wording L1/L2 failed upstream before interpretation. L3 correctly identified people but selected no evidence and asked redundant confirmation. L4 control invalid due to test-import environment leakage; generic fallback mutated isolated state. Repaired gate not demonstrated live. Three admissions of eight maximum; one valid completed live trial. Production and all protected baseline/experimental files unchanged. No secrets packaged; no commit/push. Stop for external review.

validation: Controlled designated attempts and AI-assisted six-dimension judgments; no scorer/expectation edits.
tooling: Campaign-local observer, bounded SDK transport constructor and reporting/export scripts only.
documentation: Eight reports, index and canonical session handoff.
generated_artifacts: Raw and normalized traces, transcripts, accounting, state snapshots, hashes and standard review export.

testing.focused: 102 non-HTTP boundary tests passed, 3 API tests deselected, exit 0.
testing.broader: Initial 133-test HTTP slice interrupted at Windows TestClient boundary; no completed result.
testing.runtime_validation: Four designated attempts: two upstream failures, one inadequate live paraphrase, one invalid live control.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini; only L3 returned actual gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14; SDK retries zero.
testing.new_regressions: No production change; L4 invalid harness cannot establish a new production regression.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Global accounting source manifest stale solely for the reviewed routing repair; dispatch fingerprints unchanged.

campaign_specific: L3 redundant clarification and ignored available people evidence.
L4 fixture import disabled interpretation and isolated fallback mutated state.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review D inconclusive verdict and invalid-control authority evidence.

missing_concepts: No new semantic subsystem or authority proposed.
does_not_prove: Original repair reproduced live, valid mechanical control, broad conversation quality, independent generalization, full-suite green, unconditional authority preservation or exact total cost.
recommended_next_step: External review, then separately authorized bounded validation-readiness recovery and missing original/control trials in ATGB-R1-04. Do not implement semantic repairs.
self_contained_review_test: ZIP contains all eight reports, exact exchanges, raw/normalized traces, full pre/post state, accounting and status; source hashes and CRC verified.
